blocks.text: EST. RESTORATION SINCE THE GLORY DAYS
Educate first. Sell second. Preserve the story.

Fitzgerald Classics is being built as a trusted resource for classic American automobile restoration: project journals, technical articles, videos, vendor notes, honest reviews, and a future AI assistant that answers only from approved knowledge sources.
A detail-driven Corvette restoration journal built around research, originality, documentation, and repeatable lessons for other C2 owners.
A compact American classic with big educational value: sheet metal, trim sourcing, interior decisions, and first-time hobbyist lessons.
A full-size Ford project focused on drivetrain confidence, body alignment, chrome, electrical reliability, and period-correct presence.
A plain-English guide to polarity, charging systems, and why old wiring assumptions can become expensive mistakes.
How to decide when originality matters, when reproduction parts make sense, and how to record the decision.
A starter reference for matching factory engine colors, finish quality, and documentation standards.
What to inspect before purchase, how to think about documentation, and where first-time buyers get surprised.
A project-oriented walkaround showing how to document condition and originality before teardown.
A practical shop-floor look at testing vintage charging, lighting, and ignition systems.
Progress notes on parts sourcing, interior planning, and making a small classic roadworthy.
More ways into the restoration story.
Shop notes, walkarounds, and trusted restoration clips organized by project and topic.
Parts, tools, paints, and vendors judged by real restoration use.
Project updates, technical notes, and new garage stories in one place.
Trusted sources with context, disclosure, and recommended-use notes.
Built to answer from Fitzgerald Classics content and approved restoration sources, not random general web results.
